units.source_text: “养父母既然那么疼爱我，我就不想找生身父母了。

en.t: Since my adoptive parents loved me so much, I no longer wanted to look for my birth parents.

units.source_text: 他们大概早已成了仇野 [3] 附近无人凭吊的游魂了吧，石碑都已经破旧不堪……”

en.t: They had probably long since become wandering spirits near Adashino [3], with no one to mourn them, and even their gravestones must have fallen into ruin...
